label: علي — نجدي
ref_text: معك حق أم فهد، وأنا متأسف على هاللخبطة. خليني أتأكد، طلبك خمسة ستة ثلاثة سبعة أربعة ثمانية، صح، وإذا جاب لك التطبيق موعد غلط نعدل لك الجدول.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_v4/wavs/dd3a19d523d5.wav (id najdi_v4_dd3a19d523d5: in the najdi_v4 val split, which the run measured its loss on but never trained on)
notes: Ali (a synthesiser voice described as Saudi Arabic, the most used Saudi male voice in its library), a Najdi male support agent: one of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (2,615 of his clips, 5.5 h, in Najdi and MSA). An agent apologising and checking an order number. It replaces, on 2026-10-05, a 5.9 s customer's line that the data's judge gave 66 for naturalness, and was chosen by ear from the audition page of that day. He has no held-out agent line of 9.5-18 s in a warm manner, so the candidates were his nine neutral agent lines and five warm customer lines; of the five cloned on six sentences (four short, two long) with the shipped model, this one gave the most natural clones (UTMOS +0.25 over the short clip, beyond two standard errors) and they are somewhat less like him (similarity -0.04). To the accent classifier he remains the least Saudi-sounding of the six trained voices.
